attacks.name: Knuckle Spike Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Ambush|: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.

attacks.name: Army of Squirrels
steps: If this attack deals |!damage|, after this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| and |§stun§Stun| special conditions.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, Push it |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Tippy-Toe Takedown!
superPowers.body: This character may spend any amount of |!power| to use this superpower. Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character with a |!threat| equal to or lower than the amount of |!power| spent to use this superpower. Move the |<tippy-toe>Tippy-Toe| token to that character. While that character has the Tippy-Toe token, it does not add |!critical| results in its attack, defense, or dodge rolls to its total successes and cannot add dice to its attack, defense, or dodge rolls as a result of |!critical| results.

superPowers.name: Tippy Come Back!
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack it may use this superpower. Move the |<tippy-toe>Tippy-Toe| token to this character from anywhere.

superPowers.name: Squirrelese
superPowers.body: This character begins the Game with a |<tippy-toe>Tippy-Toe| token. While this character has the Tippy-Toe token, it may reroll up to 2 dice when making an attack, defense, or dodge roll. During the |*Power Phase|, you may move the token from anywhere to this character. Whenever a character is Dazed or KO'd while it has the Tippy-Toe token, move the Tippy-Toe token to this character. This character cannot have a Tippy-Toe token except the one it begins the Game with. When this character is removed from the battlefield, remove its Tippy-Toe token from the Game.|\|Additionally, when this character is Dazed, move the Tippy-Toe token to this character from anywhere.

superPowers.name: Guardian Squirrel
superPowers.body: When this character would be KO'd by an enemy effect, if it has the |<tippy-toe>Tippy-Toe| token, remove the token from the Game. This character removes 1 |!damage|, is not KO'd, and may be Placed within |!range| 2 of its current position. Then this character cannot have Tippy-Toe tokens for the rest of the Game.

superPowers.name: Squirrelese
superPowers.body: This character begins the Game with a |<tippy-toe>Tippy-Toe| token. While this character has the Tippy-Toe token, it may reroll up to 2 dice when making an attack, defense, or dodge roll. This character cannot have a Tippy-Toe token except the one it begins the Game with. When this character is removed from the battlefield, remove its Tippy-Toe token from the Game.
